create.title: Signed reciprocal energy and square-root-product second-moment reduction
create.statement_tex: Let J=sqrt(X), Q=J/T, a_j=chi_4(j)Xi(j/J), and let w be smooth, nonnegative, and bounded below on the support of b_k. Then weighted Cauchy reduces the fixed-interior bilinear form to E=sum_k w(k/Q)|sum_j a_j e(kX/j)|^2 with |B|^2<<Q^(-1)E. Poisson summation gives E=Q sum_(j1,j2)a_(j1)conj(a_(j2)) sum_m hat(w)(Q[m-X(1/j1-1/j2)]), whose diagonal is asymp QJ, and for odd j1,j2 the character product is (-1)^((j2-j1)/2). Under the accepted smooth fixed-interior B-process, S_k=(J/k)^(1/2) sum_(rho in {1,3})epsilon_rho sum_(r asymp k)c_rho(k,r)e(2sqrt(kX(r-rho/4))) plus controlled errors. Hence RSLS E<<QJX^epsilon is equivalent to a shifted square-root-product second moment sum_(k asymp Q)|P_k|^2<<Q^2X^epsilon, whose diagonal is already asymp Q^2. Its complete signed off-diagonal remains open.
create.next_action: Prove the lossless signed off-diagonal sum_(k asymp Q)|P_k|^2_off<<Q^2X^epsilon with the actual residue-restricted moving symbol, or find a coherent family exceeding diagonal scale.

update.next_action: The fixed-interior subcritical problem is now a target-diagonal signed square-root-product second moment. Prove its full off-diagonal with the actual moving symbol; the B-process self-return alone gives no gain.
Test the lossless shifted square-root-product off-diagonal theorem; reciprocal spacing and period-four sign pairing are insufficient before absolute values.

reject.reason: Changing the odd half-difference by one moves the reciprocal alias on unit scale, much larger than the Poisson kernel width Q^(-1); no lawful termwise alternating pairing results.
Reciprocal points cluster at the Q^(-1) scale and the unsigned off-diagonal has capacity above QJ; the character must be used before absolute values.
The audited large-sieve and spacing results do not supply the required fixed-center, moving-symbol, residue-restricted lossless signed estimate.
The B-process returns to the subcritical one-sided divisor block, while the terminal theorem applies to fixed smooth critical radial sectors near n asymp sqrt(X).

no_change.reason: The signed square-root-product off-diagonal and full cone remain open.
Round 67 proves an exact reduction only; it proves no exponent improvement.

round_assessment.reason: Round 67 converts the H/L deficit into an optimally normalized target-diagonal signed square-root-product energy and isolates the exact off-diagonal theorem, while correctly withholding RSLS and exponent promotion.
